Exercise A

Reading: Job Advertisement

Read the job posting and answer the questions.

Marketing Manager – Experience Required

Position: Marketing Manager
Location: Frankfurt, Germany
Type: Full-time, Permanent

We are seeking a Marketing Manager to lead our marketing team. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of marketing experience, strong communication skills, and proficiency in digital marketing tools. Responsibilities include developing marketing strategies, managing campaigns, and analyzing market trends. A university degree in Marketing, Business, or related field is required. Fluent English and German are essential.
